facts.text: The image is a creature reference sheet with a wide cinematic hero panel across the top and seven labeled panels arranged in two rows below.
The hero panel shows a large black dragon standing low over dark volcanic rock and shallow reflective water, with hazy smoke and orange ember or lava glow in the background.
The dragon design has several long, swept-back ivory or bone-colored horns, a spiky dorsal ridge, black scales with faint blue-green iridescence, large membranous wings, a long tail, and clawed feet.
The middle row contains three full-body turnaround panels labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR.
The bottom row contains four detail panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows a reptilian head with an orange eye, textured scales, and the bases of the large horns.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows a dark, leathery wing membrane stretched over visible elongated wing-finger supports.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a heavily scaled foot with long, curved, pale claws.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows overlapping dark scales with blue-green highlights.
The printed labels visible on the sheet are FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
Lighting is low-key and dramatic, with cool gray-blue highlights on the dragon and warm orange light from the background embers.
